reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown reconcile the 70-vs-75 totals by noting Stephen's count folds in five additional descendants of Ephraim and Manasseh born in Egypt.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Isaac of Troki's Chizzuk Emunah charges that Stephen's seventy-five in Acts flatly contradicts the seventy fixed by Genesis, Exodus, and Deuteronomy.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Isaac ben Abraham of Troki (1593), Chizzuk Emunah.

sides.snippet: All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.
sides.verseText: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.

sides.snippet: Joseph sent, and summoned Jacob, his father, and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
sides.verseText: Joseph sent, and summoned Jacob, his father, and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
